hubKinds.camping: DOC campsites by DOC visitor region (campsites.json). Huts are a fact row linking to the matching huts hub.
hubKinds.dump-stations: Not built: the only dump-station data in the app is excluded by licence (see sources.wikicamps).
hubKinds.freedom-camping: Current DOC freedom-camping notices on conservation land by DOC district (freedom.json, positions from freedomgeo.geojson). Not council bylaws.
hubKinds.huts: DOC huts by DOC visitor region (huts.json).

regionAssignment.dumpStations: No region in the source. Each is assigned the DOC region of its nearest DOC campsite or hut by great-circle distance. Approximate near region lines.

bookit.name: BookIt (partner feed)
bookit.reason: Partner data is never republished, counted or opened by this export.

doc.attribution: Source: Department of Conservation. Licensed under CC BY 4.0.
doc.changes: Filtered, counted and summarised by KiwiCamping. Coordinates rounded to about 100 m. Fee summaries are our reading of the DOC fee text. No DOC description text or photographs are reproduced.
doc.name: Department of Conservation (DOC)

wikicamps.name: WikiCamps NZ (dump stations and day-use areas in the app)
wikicamps.reason: Every record links to wikicamps.co.nz, a commercial directory whose terms do not allow republication. Only the size of the app's inventory is reported; no record is republished.
